title: Redact sensitive fields recursively
prompt: Implement solve(payload). payload["document"] may be any JSON value. Return a new redacted copy of that document directly, without an outer wrapper. For every object at any depth, if a key after Unicode casefold equals exactly "password", "token", "api_key", or "secret", replace its entire value with the string "[REDACTED]", regardless of that value's type or truthiness. Otherwise recursively process the value. Preserve key spelling, list order, numbers, booleans, null, and other strings. Similar names such as "token_count" or "secrets" must not be redacted. String contents are not scanned for keywords. All inputs are valid JSON and no input container may be mutated. Example data is synthetic; this is a structural policy, not a general detector of arbitrary credentials.

cases.name: scalar_text

input.document: The word password is ordinary text.

cases.expected: The word password is ordinary text.
